testFixtureCorrection.after: Copy terrain words and read actual output pixels synchronously in the presentation task, then await their source hash. Defer cylinder cache disposal until after capture. No renderer, dimensions, numerical data or comparison threshold changed.
testFixtureCorrection.validationScope: The full units, pyramid/browser/touch and existing-family cases ran on the identical published product source. The fixture-only correction is covered by the complete final twelve-case parity rerun and final TypeScript/build.

coverage: Four sculpt tools; all eight side/side and side/base joins; N128/N256; physical fitted and unfolded map; independent hollow banks; exact whole-gesture Undo/Redo; strict v15/v16 reopen; read-only immersive cavity and exact return pose; native inside/outside camera direction; painted-bank WebGL context loss/restoration; trusted CDP pen/touch and two-finger navigation; accepted legacy sphere/cube/cylinder/hollow family behavior and matched output pixels; Open Cylinder wall and annular rim correction compatibility.
artifactIsolation: Legacy captures were written beneath .local/pyramid-final-legacy-artifacts, preserving previous tracked evidence. Complete report is included; current raw pyramid, Open Cylinder and parity records are copied separately.
consoleLogNormalization: PowerShell console transcripts decoded to UTF-8 with LF line endings and trailing whitespace removed. Numerical JSON records and PNG captures are preserved separately.

commands.units: node --test --test-concurrency=1 src/terrain/*.test.ts src/rendering/*.test.ts src/editor/*.test.ts src/persistence/*.test.ts src/surfaces/*.test.ts
commands.legacyWorkingDirectory: .local/pyramid-final-legacy-artifacts; invoke absolute Playwright CLI/config paths; ATLAS_PREVIEW_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5265; absolute HOLLOW_POLISH_REPORT, ATLAS_PARITY_REPORT, ATLAS_PARITY_OUTPUT and OPEN_CORRECTION_OUTPUT paths

limitations: Pyramid physical holes/tunnels deferred under the conditional Phase 2 instruction: a verified five-plane triangular material/portal/protection adapter is still required. Existing families and connection contracts remain unchanged.
Elevation colors the reference shape; full displaced-terrain excavation and Tunnel Network Designer are not part of this checkpoint.
Installed headless desktop Chrome uses actual RX 6600; mobile is browser emulation, not physical-phone testing. No claim of controlling the owner Chrome/extension session.
Technical validation is separate from Ember review and owner acceptance. No later shape or host integration is authorized.
